name: NBARoster
short: Guess the NBA player from their photo — first to 10 points wins.
description: A picture-based NBA trivia game. The bot posts a photo of a player and the first person to type the correct name wins the point. Accepts first names, last names, full names, and nicknames. Run [p]nba setup once to cache all images locally. First to 10 points wins.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data.
install_msg: Thanks for installing NBA Roster! Run `[p]nba setup` once as admin to download all player photos. Then use `[p]nba start` to play!
author: jaffar21
